R/Pharma is excited to share the schedule for the R/Pharma virtual conference.  This year we will be running both Europe/US (Global) and APAC centric schedules.  

Registration is free via [this link](https://events.zoom.us/ev/Ao58QRuKpY_AuvCDVGqF3tiibvbsLw6MKXn7n_PL2vPdHVQnSAuC~AulApVxluxkRoEef4TZ6ozp1uwmnBHGti8cDERG7p01yOGKH0KXFbLhUNw){target="_blank"}.

Schedule is available below, and through the PWA for browsers and mobile at [https://rpharma-2026.sessionize.com/](https://rpharma-2026.sessionize.com/){target="_blank"}.
